sections.title: Architecture Spine
sections.content: Defines evidence-gated Artifact DAG ownership, immutable identities, closure-before-evidence, canonical evidence mechanics, range delivery, stable segments, real checks, event recovery, typed routes, cost gates, and Acceptance-only finalization.

sections.title: Memory Log
sections.content: Records CAP-1 through CAP-10, finalized companion scope, superseding lifecycle and route decisions, resolved range/runtime/history questions, and two remaining policy measurement questions.

sections.title: SPEC
sections.content: Canonical contract for Acceptance and Bootstrap efficiency: freeze valid implementation handoff, build complete closure, run deterministic checks, select mode and route, preserve three-role review, and finalize only from current evidence.

sections.title: Authority And Lifecycle
sections.content: Assigns lifecycle publishers and defines freeze, manifest, closure, required-check, mode-route, Bootstrap, and acceptance-passed contracts. Bootstrap and advisory reviewers remain non-authorizing.

sections.title: Authority Projection And Segmentation
sections.content: Requires complete authority delivery or controller-owned hash-bound projections, one canonical segment identity across assignment through retry, segment-only snapshots, inherited access proofs, and mutation rejection.

sections.title: Execution And Recovery
sections.content: Defines append-only Process Events, Effective Progress distinct from liveness, policy-bound stop-loss, lease reconciliation, bounded retries, typed status, and recovery independent of chat or manual reconstruction.

sections.title: Verification And Rollout
sections.content: Requires pre-launch cost decisions, regression and semantic corpus coverage, counter-metrics against omissions and false authorization, and M0-M2 delivery sequencing before replacing whole-directory defaults.

sections.title: Architecture Diagrams
sections.content: Shows lifecycle flow from VDD through Acceptance, mode-route branching, isolated Bootstrap review, and attempt-to-reconciliation retry state transitions.

sections.title: Glossary
sections.content: Defines Acceptance, Bootstrap Complete Review, closure, required checks, projections, segments, process events, lifecycle states, typed routes, modes, supervised decisions, and non-authorizing outcomes.
